blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Low-dose and thin-slice computed tomography (CT) images suffer from elevated noise that obscures anatomical detail, while clean references for supervised denoising are often unavailable. Although Noise2Noise permits self-supervised training from noisy pairs, direct regression tends to oversmooth fine structure. Averaging multiple independently generated samples mitigates this blur, though repeating multi-step diffusion sampling is costly. We introduce Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow (N2N-iMF) to accelerate this process via few-step sampling. N2N-iMF learns to generate one noisy image conditioned on its paired counterpart; at inference, independent outputs are sampled and averaged to suppress noise. We evaluated image quality and sampling efficiency on simulated thin-slice brain and low-dose abdominal CT across four sampling methods and averaging counts from 1 to 20, and validated the approach on real-world photon-counting CT (PCCT) brain scans. With ten samples per conditioning input and three network evaluations per sample, N2N-iMF achieved a mean absolute error of 2.60 HU on brain CT and 14.02 HU on abdominal CT, outperforming 50-evaluation denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) sampling (2.91 and 14.53 HU). On the same GPU, per-output generation time dropped from 7.29 to 0.43 s. Across eight PCCT cases, N2N-iMF reached a mean gray-white matter contrast-to-noise ratio of 1.341, versus 0.916 for Noise2Noise and 1.176 for DDIM. N2N-iMF accelerates self-supervised generative CT denoising without distillation while keeping the number of averaged outputs adjustable at inference.
blocks.zh: 低剂量和薄切片计算成像仪(CT)的图像受到高噪声的影响,模糊了解剖细节,而用于监督解密的清洁参考却往往得不到。 虽然Noise2Noise允许由吵吵的对子进行自我监督的训练,但直接回归往往会使精细的结构过于平稳. 利用多个独立生成的样本减轻了这种模糊性,尽管重复多步骤的传播取样费用高昂。 我们采用改进平均流量的噪声(N2N-IMF),通过几步取样加快这一过程。 N2N-IMF学习生成一个以配对对应物为条件的噪音图像;推论,独立输出被采样并平均抑制噪音. 我们评价了模拟薄片脑和低剂量腹部CT的图像质量和采样效率,通过四种取样方法和平均计数从1到20,并验证了现实世界光子计数CT(PCCT)脑扫描方法。 N2N-IMF通过每次调压输入的10个样本和每个样本的3个网络评价,实现了大脑CT的2.60HU和腹部CT的14.02HU的平均绝对误差,超过了50评价的去诺扩散隐性模型(DDIM)取样(2.91和14.53HU). 在同一GPU上,每个输出生成时间从7.29秒降至0.43秒. 在8个PCCT病例中,N2N-iMF的灰白物质对噪声的平均比为1.341,而噪声2Noise为0.916,DDIM为1.176。 N2N-iMF在不蒸馏的情况下加速自我监督的基因CT去诺化,同时保持平均输出数量在推论时可以调整.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Low-dose computed tomography (CT) lowers patient radiation exposure, but reduced photon counts increase image noise and degrade the visibility of low-contrast anatomy [ 1 ] . A similar trade-off arises in thin-slice reconstruction, where improved through-plane resolution comes at the cost of elevated noise [ 2 ] , as well as in high-resolution photon-counting CT (PCCT) [ 3 , 4 ] . Although deep networks can suppress CT noise effectively, supervised training relies on spatially aligned low- and normal-dose image pairs. Unpaired methods relax the requirement for pixel-level alignment, yet they still need a separate set of high-quality scans that may be difficult to obtain.
blocks.zh: 低剂量计算成像法(CT)降低患者的辐射照射,但光子计数减少会增加图像噪音,降低低孔断层解剖学的能见度[1]. 在薄片重建中也会出现类似的权衡,通过飞机溶解得到改进的代价是高噪音[2],以及高分辨率光子计数CT[3,4]。 虽然深层网络能够有效抑制CT噪声,但受监督的培训依赖于空间对齐的低剂量和正常剂量的图像对. 未放任的方法放宽了像素级对齐的要求,然而它们仍然需要一套单独的高质量扫描,可能难以获得.

blocks.en: Noise2Noise eliminates the need for clean training targets by learning directly from paired noisy observations [ 5 ] . When two observations share the same underlying anatomy and carry independent, zero-mean noise, predicting one from the other has the same squared-error optimum as supervised training with clean images. In CT, suitable pairs can be formed either by reconstructing disjoint subsets of projection data or by pairing adjacent thin slices with nearly identical anatomy [ 6 , 2 ] . Because squared-error regression estimates the conditional mean of the clean image, however, the denoised output tends to oversmooth fine anatomical detail.
blocks.zh: 噪声2 噪声通过直接从对齐的噪音观测中学习来消除清洁训练目标的需求[5]. 当两个观测结果共享相同的基础解剖学,并携带独立零度噪音时,预测其中之一具有与带清洁图像的受监督训练相同的方格-误差最佳. 在CT中,合适的配对可以通过重建投影数据的脱节子集或者通过将相邻的薄片与近似相同的解剖学[6,2]配对而形成. 因为平方-error回归估计了清洁图像的有条件平均值,然而,去诺化的输出往往会过度流畅细细解剖细节.

blocks.en: To preserve fine structure without clean references, Chen et al. [ 2 ] trained a conditional diffusion model to learn the distribution of noisy targets and averaged multiple independent samples at inference. Although denoising diffusion implicit models (DDIM) reduce the number of steps required for each output [ 7 ] , generating multiple realizations still scales the total inference cost with the number of outputs. In contrast, Mean Flow and Improved Mean Flow (iMF) predict the velocity averaged over a finite time interval rather than the instantaneous velocity, allowing larger updates along the trajectory and generation in only one or a few network evaluations [ 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 为保持精细的结构,没有干净的参考文献,Chen等人. [2] 训练了有条件的传播模型,以学习吵闹的目标的分布,并在推断时平均获得多个独立的样本. 虽然去诺扩散隐含模型(DDIM)减少了每个产出所需的步骤数[7],但生成的多重实现仍以产出数来衡量推论总成本. 与此相反,平均流量和改良平均流量预测在一定时间间隔而不是瞬时速度内的平均速度,只允许在一次或几次网络评价[8、9]中对轨迹和生成情况进行更大的更新。

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow (N2N-iMF) to accelerate sample-averaged generative CT denoising. Our main contributions are as follows: 1. We formulate N2N-iMF, a self-supervised few-step conditional generator trained solely on paired noisy images without clean references, which suppresses noise by averaging independent generated outputs while retaining fine anatomical structure. 2. Using three network evaluations per output ( N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 ), N2N-iMF generates each output approximately 17 times faster than DDIM with 50 evaluations, making averaging over K K independent realizations practical without distillation while keeping K K adjustable at inference. 3. We validate N2N-iMF on simulated low-dose abdominal CT, simulated thin-slice brain CT, and real-world PCCT, demonstrating improved noise suppression and detail preservation over competing self-supervised methods in both quantitative metrics and visual assessments.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了有改进平均流量的噪声2(N2N-IMF),以加速样本平均基因CT去诺化. 我们的主要贡献如下: 1. 我们制定了N2N-iMF,这是一种自控的几步有条件生成器,专门在配对的噪音图像上培训,没有干净的参考,它通过平均独立生成的输出来抑制噪音,同时保留精细的解剖结构。 2. N2N-iMF利用每次产出的三次网络评价(N FE = 3 N_{\ mathrm{FE}}=3),每一次产出的生成速度大约是DDIM的17倍,有50次评价,使得平均超过K的独立实现在不蒸馏的情况下切实可行,同时保持K K的可调整推论. 3. 我们在模拟低剂量腹部CT、模拟薄虱脑CT和现实世界PCT上验证N2N-IMF,表明在定量计量和视觉评估方面,噪声抑制和细节保存比相互竞争的自我监督方法更好的。

blocks.en: We formulate N2N-iMF, a self-supervised few-step conditional generator trained solely on paired noisy images without clean references, which suppresses noise by averaging independent generated outputs while retaining fine anatomical structure.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了N2N-IMF, 一种自控的几步有条件的生成器, 完全在配对的噪音图像上训练, 没有干净的参考, 它通过平均独立生成的输出来抑制噪音, 同时保留精细的解剖结构。

blocks.en: Using three network evaluations per output ( N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 ), N2N-iMF generates each output approximately 17 times faster than DDIM with 50 evaluations, making averaging over K K independent realizations practical without distillation while keeping K K adjustable at inference.
blocks.zh: N2N-iMF利用每次输出的三次网络评价(N FE = 3 N_{\ mathrm{FE}}=3),每一次产出的产生速度大约是DDIM的17倍,有50个评价,使得平均超过K的独立实现在不蒸馏的情况下切实可行,同时保持KK可调整的推论.

blocks.en: We validate N2N-iMF on simulated low-dose abdominal CT, simulated thin-slice brain CT, and real-world PCCT, demonstrating improved noise suppression and detail preservation over competing self-supervised methods in both quantitative metrics and visual assessments.
blocks.zh: 我们在模拟低剂量腹部CT、模拟薄虱脑CT和现实世界PCT上验证N2N-iMF,表明在定量测量和视觉评估方面,对相互竞争的自我监督方法加强了噪音抑制和细节保存。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Supervised and unpaired CT denoising
blocks.zh: 2.1 监管和无监管的CT解密

blocks.en: Supervised CT denoisers, such as RED-CNN [ 10 ] and the directional wavelet network of Kang et al. [ 11 ] , learn direct mappings from low-dose inputs to aligned higher-quality targets. Because pixelwise losses tend to oversmooth fine texture, later approaches incorporated adversarial and perceptual objectives to better preserve image sharpness [ 12 , 13 ] . When aligned pairs are unavailable, unpaired methods instead learn from separate low- and routine-dose collections, typically under a cycle-consistency constraint [ 14 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 监制CT denoisers,如RED-CNN[10]和Kang等人的方向波浪网. [11],从低剂量投入中学习直接映射到一致的高质量目标. 由于像素损失往往使精细的纹理过于平滑,后来的方法包含了对抗性和知觉性的目标,以更好地保持图像的锐度[12,13]. 在无法使用对齐配对时,未加规范的方法则从单独的低剂量和例行剂量收集中学习,通常在周期一致性的制约下学习[14、15]。

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-supervised CT denoising
blocks.zh: 2.2 自我监督的CT解禁

blocks.en: Self-supervised methods avoid clean reference scans altogether. Building on Noise2Noise, which replaces clean targets with independent noisy observations [ 5 ] , CT denoising approaches construct training pairs from disjoint measurement subsets or neighboring slices [ 6 , 16 , 17 ] . When paired data are unavailable, blind-spot methods such as Noise2Void and Noise2Self predict held-out pixels from their surroundings [ 18 , 19 ] , whereas Noise2Sim pairs structurally similar regions as training targets [ 20 ] . Taking a statistical approach, Noise2Score derives a clean estimate from the score of the noisy image distribution together with a noise model [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 自我监督的方法完全避免了清洁的参考扫描. 以Noise2Noise为基础,用独立的噪声观测取代了干净的目标[5],CT调试方法从脱节的测量子集或相邻切片中构建培训对 [6, 16, 17]. 当无法提供配对数据时,Noise2Void和Noise2Self等盲点方法预测其周围的持有像素[18,19],而Noise2Sim则在结构上与培训目标[20]相似。 采用统计方法,Noise2Score从吵闹的图像分布的得分中得出一个干净的估计,加上噪音模型[21].

blocks.en: More recently, generative self-supervised methods have been explored to mitigate regression blur. DDM 2 first applies a preliminary denoiser to estimate the noise level and matches the noisy input to an intermediate diffusion state before reverse denoising [ 22 ] . When paired noisy CT scans are available, Chen et al. [ 2 ] instead train a conditional diffusion model to generate noisy targets and average independent outputs to obtain the denoised image.
blocks.zh: 最近,探索了基因自我监督的方法,以减少回归模糊。 DDM 2首先应用一个初步的denoiser来估计噪声水平,并在反向除号[22]前将噪声输入与中间扩散状态相匹配. 当对齐的吵闹的CT扫描可用时,Chen et al. [2] 相反,训练一种有条件的传播模式,以产生吵闹的目标以及平均的独立输出,以获得被取消的图像.

blocks.en: 2.3 Flow-based generative models in medical imaging
blocks.zh: 2.3 医学成像中的流源基因模型

blocks.en: Flow matching and rectified flow learn a continuous velocity field that transports noise into images [ 23 , 24 ] . In medical imaging, flow-based modeling has been applied to MRI reconstruction using only undersampled measurements [ 25 ] . For CT, the Poisson Flow Generative Model++ (PFGM++) supplies an image prior for denoising [ 4 ] , and conditional Mean Flow has been studied across images reconstructed with different kernels and slice thicknesses [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 流匹配和修正流会学习一个将噪声传送到图像的连续速度场[23,24]. 在医学成像中,流基模型被应用到核磁共振的重建中,只使用被下取样的测量[25]. 对于CT,Poisson Flow Generative Model ++(PFGM++)在调试[4]前提供一个图像,有条件的均匀流量已被研究到不同内核和切片厚度重建的图像之间[26].

blocks.en: Standard diffusion models generate images by iteratively predicting and removing added noise [ 27 ] , which makes inference slow. Efforts to accelerate sampling generally follow two directions: reducing the number of numerical updates or learning a direct mapping to the trajectory endpoint. Along the first direction, DDIM reduces the required sampling steps [ 7 ] , while elucidated diffusion models (EDM) improve both training and numerical solvers [ 28 ] . Along the second, consistency models map noisy states directly to the endpoint [ 29 ] , an approach adapted via consistency distillation in Poisson Flow Consistency Models for single-step CT denoising [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 标准扩散模型通过迭代预测和去除添加的噪音来生成图像[27],这使得推论缓慢. 加速采样的努力一般遵循两个方向:减少数字更新数量或学习直接绘制到轨迹终点. 沿着第一个方向,DDIM减少了所需的采样步骤[7],同时阐明传播模型(EDM)改进了培训和数字解析器[28]. 沿着第二段,一致性模型映射出响亮的状态,直接到达终点[29],这种方法通过一致性蒸馏在Poisson Flow一致性模型中被修改,用于单步CT解析[30].

blocks.en: Rather than relying on fine time discretization or distillation, Mean Flow predicts the velocity averaged over a time interval so that sampling can advance in larger updates [ 8 ] . iMF further reformulates its training as regression on the velocity at the current time [ 9 ] . In N2N-iMF, we adopt this few-step generator to learn from noisy CT pairs and efficiently produce independent realizations for denoising by sample averaging.
blocks.zh: " 平均流动 " 不依赖精细的时间盘式或蒸馏,而是预测一个时间间隔内平均速度,以便采样能在更大的更新[8]中取得进展。 iMF进一步将其训练重新表述为当前速度的回归[9]. 在N2N-iMF中,我们采用这个几步生成器,从吵闹的CT对学习,并高效地产生独立实现,通过样本平均去Noing.

blocks.en: For brain CT and PCCT, we additionally fine-tune the trained generator with a PatchGAN adversarial loss to better match the local texture of noisy targets [ 31 ] , with the discriminator comparing high-frequency residuals obtained by subtracting a 7 × 7 7\times 7 local average.

blocks.en: 3.5 Inference
blocks.zh: 3.5 推论

blocks.en:
At inference, generation starts from Gaussian noise x 1 = ϵ x_{1}=\epsilon while holding the conditioning input y 1 y_{1} fixed.
Stepping backward from t = 1 t=1 to t = 0 t=0 , the network u θ u_{\theta} predicts the average velocity over each subinterval [ s , t ] [s,t] , and the state is updated via x s = x t − ( t − s ) ​ u θ ​ ( x t , y 1 , s , t ) , s < t . x_{s}=x_{t}-(t-s)u_{\theta}(x_{t},y_{1},s,t),\qquad s<t. (10) After N FE N_{\mathrm{FE}} updates, the terminal state x 0 x_{0} gives one generated output y 2 ( k ) y_{2}^{(k)} . Repeating this procedure from K K independent Gaussian initializations and averaging the resulting outputs yields the denoised estimate z ^ K \widehat{z}_{K} in Eq. ( 6 ).
4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset description
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集说明

blocks.en: The simulated abdominal CT dataset comprised 10 normal-dose cases from the AAPM Low Dose CT Grand Challenge [ 1 ] , split into seven cases for training and three for testing. Images with 2 mm slice thickness served as clean references, and low-dose scans were simulated by adding Gaussian noise in the projection domain followed by filtered backprojection (FBP) with a soft-tissue kernel. Each sinogram was split into two disjoint subsets to form a Noise2Noise pair [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 模拟腹部CT数据集包含来自APM低剂量CT大挑战[1]的10个正常剂量病例,分为7个用于培训的病例和3个用于测试的病例. 带有2毫米切片厚度的图像作为干净的参考,低剂量扫描被模拟,在投影域中加入高斯噪声,然后用软组织内核过滤回投影(FBP). 每个星图被分成两个脱节子集,形成一个噪声2噪声对[6].

blocks.en: For simulated thin-slice brain CT, we used 100 retrospective scans, with 84 reserved for training and 16 for testing. Volumes with 5 mm slice thickness were interpolated to 0.625 mm to serve as clean references, and noise was simulated using the same projection-domain procedure as for abdominal CT. Training pairs were constructed from triplets of consecutive slices, taking the middle slice as the target y 2 y_{2} and stacking its two neighbors channel-wise as the conditioning input y 1 y_{1} .
blocks.zh: 对于模拟薄片脑CT,我们使用了100个追溯扫描,其中84个预留用于训练,16个用于测试. 含5毫米切片厚度的体积被插到0.625毫米以作为干净的参考,用与腹部CT相同的投影域程序模拟噪音. 训练对由连续的三重切片组成,将中间切片作为目标y 2 y _{2}并将其两个邻居的频道堆叠成条件输入y 1 y_{1}.

blocks.en: The real-world PCCT dataset consisted of 33 portable brain scans acquired at 120 kVp, 6–7 mA, and 0.707 mm slice thickness, with 25 cases used for development and eight for testing. Pairs followed the same three-slice arrangement used in simulated brain CT. Both the retrospective brain CT and PCCT collections received institutional review board approval. Across all three datasets, images had a matrix size of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels.
blocks.zh: 真实世界的PCCT数据集包括以120千伏,6–7毫升和0.707毫米切片厚度获得的33个便携式脑扫描,其中25个病例用于开发,8个用于测试. 配对遵循了模拟大脑CT中使用的相同的三切片安排. 追溯性脑电图集和PCCT集都得到了机构审查委员会的批准。 在所有三个数据集中,图像的矩阵大小为512×512 512\times 512像素.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.2 详细执行情况

blocks.en: The conditional U-Net [ 32 ] was implemented in PyTorch and trained using Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for 200 epochs on an NVIDIA A800 GPU. Inference runtime was measured separately on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU with a batch size of 1, yielding a median generation time per 512 × 512 512\times 512 output of 0.43 s for N2N-iMF ( N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 ) versus 7.29 s for DDIM ( N FE = 50 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=50 ).
blocks.zh: 有条件的U-Net [32]在PyTorch实施,使用Adam进行训练,在NVIDIA A800 GPU上的200个时代的学习率为10−4 10^{-4}. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 膝上型GPU的批量尺寸为1,在N2N-iMF(NFE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3)和DDIM(NFE = 50 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=50)512输出0.43 s上分别测得推算运行时间,得出中位生成时间。

blocks.en: For the main comparisons, we set N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 on simulated CT, and N FE = 5 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=5 and K = 20 K=20 on PCCT. On abdominal CT, K K outputs were generated from each of the two split reconstructions and all 2 ​ K 2K outputs were averaged, requiring 2 ​ K ​ N FE 2KN_{\mathrm{FE}} evaluations per slice; on brain CT and PCCT, a single conditioning input formed from the two neighboring slices required K ​ N FE KN_{\mathrm{FE}} evaluations. To evaluate the effect of sample averaging, we fixed N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and varied K K from 1 to 20 in integer steps across the three abdominal CT and 16 brain CT test cases. In this K K -sweep, the brain CT model was evaluated prior to adversarial fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 对于主要比较,我们在模拟CT上设定NFE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3和K = 10 K = 10,在PCT上设定NFE = 5 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=5和K = 20 K = 20. 在腹部CT中,K K产出分别来自两次分开的重建,所有2 K 2K产出均需2 K N FE 2KN_{\mathrm{FE}}评价每片;在大脑CT和PCCT上,从两个相邻切片形成的单调输入需要K NE KN_{\mathrm{FE}}评价. 为了评估样本平均效应,我们把N FE = 3 N_{\ mathrm{FE}}=3, 将K K从整数步骤从1到20不等,跨越三个腹部CT和16个脑CT测试病例。 在这个K K - sweep中,大脑CT模型在对抗性微调前被评价.

blocks.en: Comparison with existing self-supervised methods
blocks.zh: 与现有自我监督方法的比较

blocks.en: We compared N2N-iMF with Noise2Noise, Noise2Score, and DDM 2 [ 5 , 21 , 22 ] on the same test cohorts. To examine the impact of domain shift, the visual comparisons in Fig. 1 also included a supervised diffusion model trained with a different noise model and reconstruction kernel.
blocks.zh: 我们把N2N-iMF和Noise2Noise、Noise2Score和DDM2比作同一测试组别。 为了审查域位转移的影响,图1中的视觉比较还包括一个经过不同噪音模型和重建内核培训的有监督的传播模型.

blocks.en: Comparison of expedited sampling methods
blocks.zh: 快速抽样方法比较

blocks.en: Within the same conditional generative framework (Sec. 3.3 ), we compared N2N-iMF against DDIM [ 7 ] , EDM [ 28 ] , and flow matching [ 23 ] for accelerated inference. Each method generated K K independent noisy targets conditioned on the paired input and averaged them for denoising (Fig. 2 ). Comparisons spanned N FE = 2 , 3 , 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 , 50 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=2,3,5,10,20,30,50 at K = 10 K=10 . For PCCT, the diffusion reference used DDIM with 100 evaluations and eight averaged outputs.
blocks.zh: 在同一有条件的基因框架(第3.3条)内,我们比较了N2N-iMF与DDIM[7],EDM[28],以及流量匹配[23]以加速推论. 每种方法都产生K K 独立噪声目标,以配对输入为条件,并平均为去诺(图2 ). NFE=2、3、5、10、20、30、50 NXXMThrm{FE}2、3、5、10、20、30、50的比较值为K=10K=10。对于PCCT来说,传播参考值为DDIM,有100项评价和8项平均产出。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 评价尺度

blocks.en: Simulated images were evaluated using mean absolute error (MAE), structural similarity index (SSIM) [ 33 ] , and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) [ 34 ] , computed over intensity windows of [ − 160,240 ] [-160,240] HU for abdominal CT and [ 0,100 ] [0,100] HU for brain CT. Two-sided t t -tests were performed at N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 to compare N2N-iMF with DDIM and EDM on each metric. Quantitative results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across test cases.
blocks.zh: 模拟图像使用平均绝对误差(MAE),结构相似性指数(SSIM)[33],并学习了感知图像补丁相似性(LPIPS)[34],在强度窗口上计算,腹部CT为[−160,240]HU,大脑CT为[0,100][0,100]HU. 在N FE = 3 N_{\ mathrm{FE}}=3和K = 10 K = 10 进行了双侧 t-测试,将N2N-iMF与DDIM和EDM在每一公尺上进行比较. 量化结果报告为测试案例之间平均±\pm标准差。

blocks.en: Because low-noise reference scans were unavailable for real-world PCCT, evaluation relied on visual inspection and gray–white matter contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) measured within manually drawn regions of interest (ROIs). Display windows were matched across methods, and no histogram equalization was applied to PCCT images.
blocks.zh: 由于现实世界PCT没有低噪声参考扫描,评价依赖于视觉检查和人工绘制的有关区域(ROIs)内测得的灰色-白色物质对比-噪声比。 显示窗口在方法上进行了匹配,对PCCT图像没有应用直方图平方.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with self-supervised methods
blocks.zh: 5.1 与自我监督方法的比较

blocks.en: Across both simulated datasets, N2N-iMF achieved the lowest MAE and LPIPS and the highest SSIM among all compared self-supervised methods (Table 1 ). On brain CT, it lowered MAE from 4.12 HU for Noise2Noise to 2.60 HU, increased SSIM from 0.693 to 0.766, and reduced LPIPS from 0.0990 to 0.0497. On abdominal CT, N2N-iMF similarly reached an MAE of 14.02 HU, an SSIM of 0.731, and an LPIPS of 0.0462, improving on the corresponding Noise2Noise values of 14.60 HU, 0.695, and 0.1170.
blocks.zh: 在两个模拟数据集中,N2N-IMF实现了最低的MAE和LPIPS,在所有比较的自我监督方法中达到最高的SSIM(表1)。 在大脑CT上,它将MAE从噪声2Noise的4.12HU降低到2.60HU,将SSIM从0.693提高到0.766,并将LPIPS从0.0990降到0.0497. 在腹部CT上,N2N-IMF同样达到14.02HU的MAE,SSIM为0.731,LPIPS为0.0462,相应噪声值为14.60HU,0.695和0.1170.

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results on brain CT ( n = 16 n=16 ) and abdominal CT ( n = 3 n=3 ). N2N-iMF uses N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 . Values are mean ± \pm SD; bold indicates the best mean in each dataset.
blocks.zh: 表1:脑CT(n=16n=16)和腹CT(n=3n=3)的主要结果. N2N-iMF使用NFE=3N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3,K=10K=10. 值是平均值±\pm SD;粗体表示每个数据集中的最佳平均值.

blocks.en: Qualitative examples in Fig. 1 reflect these quantitative gains. In the magnified abdominal inset, N2N-iMF delineates small vessels more clearly than Noise2Noise, whereas the supervised diffusion model trained under mismatched noise and reconstruction conditions exhibits altered local texture. In the brain CT example, N2N-iMF suppresses background noise while keeping the structures marked by yellow arrows clearly visible.
blocks.zh: 图1中的定性实例反映了这些量化收益。 在放大的腹部陷套中,N2N-IMF比Noise2Noise更清楚地描绘了小型船只,而在不匹配的噪音和重建条件下培训的受监督的传播模型显示出当地纹理发生了变化。 在大脑CT的例子中,N2N-IMF抑制背景噪声,同时保持以黄色箭头标记的结构清晰可见.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Denoising results on simulated abdominal CT (top) and brain CT (bottom). N2N-iMF preserves small vessels in the magnified abdominal region as well as the brain structures indicated by yellow arrows.
blocks.zh: 图1:模拟腹部CT(顶部)和脑部CT(底部)的脱氧反应结果. N2N-iMF在放大的腹部区域以及黄箭指示的脑结构中保存小血管.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 5.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Comparison of expedited sampling methods
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 快速取样方法的比较

blocks.en: At N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 , N2N-iMF ranked first among the four sampling methods across every mean metric on both simulated datasets (Table 2 ). Compared with DDIM and EDM, these improvements were statistically significant for all three metrics ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 on brain CT and p < 0.01 p<0.01 on abdominal CT, two-sided t t -tests).
blocks.zh: 在NFE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3和K = 10 K = 10中,N2N-IMF在两个模拟数据集的每个平均度量的四种抽样方法中排名第一(表2)。 与DDIM和EDM相比,这些改进在统计学上对于所有三个度量标准都具有重大意义(大脑CT值 < 0.001 p < 0.001,腹部CT值 < 0.01 p < 0.01,双侧 t -测试)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Sampling comparison at N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 on brain CT ( n = 16 n=16 ) and abdominal CT ( n = 3 n=3 ). Values are mean ± \pm SD; bold indicates the best mean in each dataset.
blocks.zh: 表2:在大脑CT(n=16n=16)和腹部CT(n=3n=3n=3)上进行取样比较。 值是平均值±\pm SD;粗体表示每个数据集中的最佳平均值.

blocks.en: Even with three evaluations per output, N2N-iMF achieved a lower MAE than 50-evaluation DDIM on both brain CT (2.60 vs. 2.91 HU) and abdominal CT (14.02 vs. 14.53 HU; Fig. 2 ). Flow matching likewise maintained low MAE and high SSIM at two or three evaluations. In contrast, DDIM improved gradually as N FE N_{\mathrm{FE}} increased, while EDM showed a sharp drop in abdominal MAE between three and five evaluations before improving further up to N FE = 50 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=50 .
blocks.zh: N2N-IMF即使每次输出三次评价,在大脑CT(2.60对2.91HU)和腹部CT(14.02对14.53HU;图2)上都实现了低于50评价DDIM的MAE. 同样,在两、三次评价中,流量匹配保持了低最低管理评价水平和高标准计量指标。 相比之下,随着NE FE N_{\mathrm{FE}}增加,DDIM逐渐改善,而EDM显示腹部MAE在3到5个评价之间急剧下降,然后进一步提升到NE=50 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=50.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Conditional generative denoising framework and sampling comparison at K = 10 K=10 . Shading marks the few-step regime ( N FE ≤ 5 N_{\mathrm{FE}}\leq 5 ).
blocks.zh: 图2: K=10K=10时有条件的基因去诺框架和抽样比较。 沙丁标志着少数步骤政权(N FE 5 N_{\mathrm{FE}}\leq 5 ).

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Effects of N FE N_{\mathrm{FE}} and K K
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 NFE N_{\mathrm{FE}}和KK的影响

blocks.en: For N2N-iMF at K = 10 K=10 , two or three evaluations yielded the lowest abdominal MAE and highest SSIM, while LPIPS varied little across the tested N FE N_{\mathrm{FE}} range (Fig. 2 ). On brain CT, increasing N FE N_{\mathrm{FE}} from three to five improved LPIPS but lowered SSIM.
blocks.zh: 对于K=10K=10的N2N-iMF,两三次评价得出了最低的腹部MAE和最高的SSIM,而经过测试的NFE N_{\mathrm{FE}}(图2)范围内的LPIPS差异不大. 在大脑CT上,将NFE NQQMThrm{FE}从3个改进的LPIPS增加到5个,但降低SSIM.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Effect of K K at N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 on abdominal CT ( n = 3 n=3 ). Points denote means across the three test cases, and dashed lines indicate fitted curves. Representative slices compare FBP, K = 1 , 2 , 4 , 10 K=1,2,4,10 , and ground truth (GT), with yellow boxes marking the magnified regions.
blocks.zh: 图3:K K在NFE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3对腹部CT的影响(n=3n=3). 点表示横跨三个试验箱,虚线表示安装的曲线。 代表切片比较FBP,K=1,2,4,10K=1,2,4,10,地面真假(GT),黄色框标注放大区域.

blocks.en: At N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 , increasing K K from 1 to 20 reduced abdominal MAE from 18.60 to 13.72 HU, increased SSIM from 0.628 to 0.739, and reduced LPIPS from 0.0844 to 0.0456 (Fig. 3 ). A similar pattern held on brain CT (prior to adversarial fine-tuning), where MAE decreased from 3.60 to 2.58 HU, SSIM increased from 0.616 to 0.782, and LPIPS declined from 0.1074 to 0.0610. On both datasets, gains were smaller at higher K K .
blocks.zh: 在NE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 中,K K从 1 增加到 20 个,将腹部MAE从 18.60 减少到 13.72 HU,将SSIM从 0.628增加到 0.739,将LPIPS从 0.0844减少到 0.0456 (图 3). 大脑CT(对抗性微调前)的类似模式,MAE从3.60降至2.58HU,SSIM从0.616增至0.782,LPIPS从0.1074降至0.0610. 在这两个数据集中,高KK的增益较小。

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Effect of adversarial fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 对抗性微调的效果

blocks.en: At N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 , PatchGAN adversarial fine-tuning reduced brain CT LPIPS by 22% (from 0.0637 to 0.0497), while slightly lowering MAE from 2.65 to 2.60 HU and changing SSIM from 0.769 to 0.766.
blocks.zh: 在NE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3和K = 10 K = 10,PatchGAN 对抗性微调将大脑CT LPIPS降低22%(从0.0637降至0.0497),同时将MAE从2.65降至2.60HU,并将SSIM从0.769降至0.766.

blocks.en: 5.3 Performance on real-world PCCT
blocks.zh: 5.3 现实世界PCT的表现

blocks.en: Across the eight PCCT test cases, N2N-iMF achieved the highest mean gray–white matter CNR of 1.341, compared with 0.916 for Noise2Noise and 1.176 for DDIM (Fig. 4 ). Visually, it suppressed background noise while maintaining clear delineation of the cortical sulci marked by yellow arrows.
blocks.zh: 在8个PCCT试验病例中,N2N-IMF的平均灰白色物质为1.341,而噪声2Noise为0.916,DDIM为1.176(图4)。 在视觉上,它压制了背景噪声,同时保持了以黄色箭头标记的皮质淤泥的明确划分.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Denoising results on real-world thin-slice brain PCCT. Yellow arrows highlight cortical sulci, and the bar chart summarizes mean gray–white matter CNR ( ± \pm SD) across the eight test cases.
blocks.zh: 图4:真实世界薄片脑PCCT的脱落结果. 黄箭突出皮质硫化物,条形图总结了8个测试案例的中灰色-白色物质CNR(±\pm SD).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this study, we developed N2N-iMF to accelerate self-supervised generative CT denoising without sacrificing image quality. Trained directly on paired noisy observations, the model generates independent realizations whose average suppresses noise while preserving anatomical detail. Using projection splitting for simulated abdominal CT and adjacent-slice pairing for simulated brain CT, N2N-iMF outperformed the compared self-supervised methods in both image fidelity and perceptual similarity (Table 1 ). On real-world PCCT scans, it likewise achieved the highest mean gray–white matter CNR while preserving the cortical sulci highlighted in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们开发了N2N-iMF,以在不牺牲图像质量的情况下,加速自我监督的基因CT去诺. 该模型直接在对齐的噪音观测上训练,生成独立实现,其平均抑制噪音,同时保留解剖细节. N2N-IMF利用模拟腹部CT和模拟脑部CT的相邻切片配对的投影分裂,在图像忠诚度和知觉相似度上都超过了比较的自我监督方法(表1)。 在现实世界的PCCT扫描中,它同样实现了最高的中间灰白物质CNR,同时保留了Fig中突出的皮质固态. 4 (英语).

blocks.en: Learning from noisy pairs eliminates the need for both clean reference targets and an explicit CT noise model, allowing the generator to adapt directly to the noise characteristics of the target acquisition setting. By contrast, the supervised model trained under mismatched noise and reconstruction conditions altered local texture and small structures (Fig. 1 ). N2N-iMF also bypasses the preliminary noise-estimation step that DDM 2 relies on to match an input to an intermediate diffusion state [ 22 ] ; inaccuracies in that estimate may explain the residual noise seen in DDM 2 ’s PCCT outputs (Fig. 4 ). In addition, because denoising is performed by averaging generated realizations, the sample count K K can be adjusted at inference to control denoising strength and computation without retraining.
blocks.zh: 从吵吵的对子中学习可以消除对干净的参考指标和明确的CT噪声模型的需要,使发电机能够直接适应目标获取设定的噪声特性. 相比之下,在不匹配的噪音和重建条件下培训的受监督模型改变了当地纹理和小结构(图1)。 N2N-IMF还绕过了DDM 2所依赖的初步噪声估计步骤,将输入与中间扩散状态相匹配[22];该估计中的不准确可能解释DDM中看到的残留噪声. 2 PCT的产出(图4)。 此外,由于去诺化是通过平均生成的实现来完成的,因此可以推论对KK样本数进行调整,以控制去诺化强度和计算而无需再培训.

blocks.en: Few-step generation is what makes this adjustable averaging computationally practical. Generating a single output took 0.43 s with N2N-iMF versus 7.29 s for 50-evaluation DDIM, markedly lowering the cost of repeated sampling without distillation. At N FE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3 and K = 10 K=10 , N2N-iMF significantly outperformed DDIM and EDM across all three metrics ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 on brain CT and p < 0.01 p<0.01 on abdominal CT, two-sided t t -tests; Table 2 ), while mean MAE, SSIM, and LPIPS also favored N2N-iMF over flow matching. Numerical discretization error from large sampling steps may contribute to the higher errors observed for DDIM and EDM at three evaluations [ 7 , 28 ] . By comparison, straight conditional paths in flow matching simplify velocity regression [ 23 ] , while iMF directly learns the velocity averaged over a time interval to support larger updates [ 8 , 9 ] . For N2N-iMF at K = 10 K=10 , increasing N FE N_{\mathrm{FE}} from three to five improved brain CT LPIPS but reduced SSIM (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 少步生成使得这种可调整平均计算实用。 用N2N-IMF产生单一产出需要0.43 s,而用50 s评价DDIM则需要7.29 s,明显降低了不蒸馏重复取样的成本。 在NE = 3 N_{\mathrm{FE}}=3和K = 10 K = 10, N2N-iMF在所有三个度量标准上都明显优于DDIM和EDM(在大脑CT上为 < 0.001 p<0.001,在腹部CT上为 < 0.01 p<0.01,双侧 t - t测试;表2)),而平均值为MAE,SSIM,LPIPS也倾向于N2N-iMF在流量匹配上. 大型采样步骤产生的数字盘化误差可能导致在三次评价中观察到的DDIM和EDM较高的误差[7,28]. 相比之下,流量匹配中的直接条件路径简化速度回归[23],而iMF直接学习在一个时间间隔内平均速度,以支持更大的更新[8,9]. 对于K=10K=10的N2N-iMF,将NFE N_{\mathrm{FE}}从3个改进后的大脑CTLPIPS增加至5个,但减少了SSIM(图2).

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations of this study should be noted. First, the real-world PCCT evaluation covered only eight test cases without low-noise reference images, and thus relied on CNR and visual inspection without assessing diagnostic accuracy or false-positive and false-negative findings. Second, the adjacent-slice pairing strategy used for brain CT and PCCT assumes closely matching anatomy between neighboring slices. Future work will expand evaluation to larger clinical datasets, include paired low-noise references where available, and conduct reader studies to evaluate anatomical fidelity and lesion detection accuracy.
blocks.zh: 应指出这项研究的几个局限性。 首先,现实世界的PCCT评价只涵盖8个没有低噪音参考图像的测试案例,因此依赖CNR和视觉检查,而没有评估诊断准确性或虚假的阳性和阴性结论. 其次,用于大脑CT和PCCT的相邻切片配对策略假设邻切片之间的解剖学紧密匹配. 今后的工作将扩大评价范围,使之包括更大的临床数据集,包括现有的对等低噪声参考,并进行读者研究,以评估解剖忠诚度和损伤检测准确性。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have presented N2N-iMF, a self-supervised CT denoising method that combines few-step generative modeling with sample averaging. Without requiring clean reference images or model distillation, a single trained model supports adjustable averaging counts at inference. Using three evaluations per output, N2N-iMF achieved lower MAE than 50-evaluation DDIM on both simulated datasets while reducing per-output generation time from 7.29 to 0.43 s, and delivered higher gray–white matter CNR than Noise2Noise and DDIM on real-world PCCT.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了N2N-iMF,这是一种自我监督的CT除诺方法,结合了几步基因模型和平均样本. 在不要求清洁的参考图像或模型蒸馏的情况下,一个经过培训的单一模型支持可调整的推算平均计数。 N2N-IMF利用每次产出的三次评价,在模拟数据集上实现了低于50评价DDIM的MAE,同时将每个产出的生成时间从7.29秒减少到0.43秒,并在现实世界PCT上提供了高于Noise2Noise和DDIM的灰白色物质CNR.
